subject: Security evidence & next steps from demo — SOC2, pen test, procurement
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@finexa.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Security evidence & next steps from demo

Hi Ethan / Lina —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the procurement path forward: 

Recap:
- Economic buyer / procurement contact: Samuel Price (you mentioned he owns final sign-off)
- Security reviewers: Lina (infosec) + procurement SME (Samuel)
- Key decision criteria you called out: latency/cost per 1k tokens, data residency, auditability (logs) and a clean SOC2/pen test profile

Requested evidence (we committed to):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Pen test summary (high level findings, remediation status)
- Sample audit logs (redacted) and answers on data retention/encryption/KMS
- Security-evidence checklist for your procurement team (I’ll attach)

Proposed timeline / next steps:
1) We’ll assemble the evidence package and share SOC2 + pen test summary + audit-log sample by EOD Monday 6/15.
2) Marissa (cc’d) will own delivery and follow-up on any additional questions from your security team.
3) Once procurement confirms, we can kick off contract redlines (DocuSign/Legal) and aim for a 4–6 week procurement window.

Can you confirm the stakeholder list above and whether we’ve missed any other reviewers? Also please confirm if Samuel is the right person to include on the next send.

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally to assign ownership.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx (will be sent with Marissa’s package)

From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@finexa.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@finexa.com>
Cc: Samuel Price <samuel.price@finexa.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security evidence & next steps from demo

Thanks Neha — that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Confirmed: Samuel Price is the economic buyer and will own procurement timeline. Please include him on future evidence sends.
- Lina will lead the security review. She will want the SOC2 report, pen test summary (high-level), and a redacted sample of audit logs showing authentication and API access events.
- Procurement questions:
  - Can Redwood provide standard DPA (or confirm you’ll sign ours)?
  - Data retention defaults and options (how long do you retain logs/inputs, can we set retention windows per workspace?)
  - Encryption: at-rest and in-transit details and KMS/HSM options for key management

Timeline: if we get the evidence package by 6/15, procurement + security will review and aim to respond with redlines within ~2 weeks. Procurement may also request insurance certificate and vendor risk questionnaire.

Please include links to any artifact storage (Drive/DocuSign) and drop any HubSpot/Doc IDs if useful.

Thanks — looking forward to the package.

—Ethan
Ethan Shaw | Head of Platform Engineering, Finexa
ethan.shaw@finexa.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security evidence & next steps from demo

Looping in Marissa to own evidence delivery and follow-up. Plan is below: 

Action owner & deliverables:
- Marissa: prepare SOC2 report (redacted as needed), pen test summary, audit-log sample JSON, and the security-evidence-checklist.xlsx. Target: 2026-06-15 EOD.
- Legal / Rev Ops: pull standard DPA and insurance cert (I’ll coordinate).
- Neha: confirm procurement contact (Samuel) and keep sales cadence for contract timeline.

Notes for packaging:
- SOC2: provide cover letter with scope/dates and contact for auditor questions.
- Pen test: 1–2 page high-level summary (no PII), remediation status for any critical/high findings.
- Audit logs: redacted example with timestamps, user-id hashes, api_key_id redacted — include short README describing retention semantics.
- Data retention: short Q/A doc clarifying default retention (90 days for request-context logs), options for longer retention on dedicated/private deployments, and export controls.

Marissa — please send the package to Ethan + Lina + Samuel and CC Neha/Ben. If any item will slip past 6/15, flag now so we can set expectations.

Ben
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@finexa.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@finexa.com>, Samuel Price <samuel.price@finexa.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Security evidence package — Redwood (SOC2, pen test, audit logs sample)

Hi Ethan / Lina / Samuel —

Per our thread and Neha’s recap, attaching the requested evidence package. If you need any further detail or a walkthrough of any item, I’m happy to hop on a quick call.

What’s attached:
- Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf — SOC2 Type II report with auditor cover letter (redacted as appropriate)
- redwood_pen_test_summary_2026.pdf — high-level pen test summary and remediation status
- audit-logs-sample.json — redacted example showing auth and API access events
- security-evidence-checklist.xlsx — checklist aligned to procurement asks

Short answers to the frequent questions you raised:
- Data retention: default request-context logs retained 90 days. For Dedicated/Private deployments we can provide configurable retention windows; for Hosted we can discuss a longer-term retention add-on.
- Encryption & KMS: encryption at-rest and in-transit by default. We support customer-managed keys via KMS for Dedicated/Private plans (HSM integrations available).
- DPA & insurance: we have a standard DPA we can provide and a current insurance certificate — Ben will share.

Next steps:
- Please confirm whether you want the SOC2 PDF as-is or with further redactions.
- Let us know if procurement wants the DPA now; we can circulate DocuSign.
- If there are follow-up technical questions, Lina / Ethan, we can set up a short call with our security engineering team (Marissa + SRE).

Thanks — hope this helps speed review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf, redwood_pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, audit-logs-sample.json, security-evidence-checklist.xlsx

From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@finexa.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samuel Price <samuel.price@finexa.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@finexa.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security evidence package — Redwood (SOC2, pen test, audit logs sample)

Marissa / team —

Received, thanks for the quick turnaround. I’ll circulate to procurement and security for review. A couple quick asks: 

- Procurement will likely request a signed DPA — do you have a copy you can send now (or the DocuSign link)?
- Any estimate on how long contract redlines typically take on your side once we submit (to set internal expectations)?

We should plan a short follow-up call next week (Samuel is available Tue/Wed afternoon PT). Can you and Neha run availability?

Thanks again — this is exactly what procurement/security needed to start.

—Ethan
